Set up a push service with its credentials, and turn it on.

Usage:
  voidhash push config set <command> [flags]

Commands:
  apns       Send to iOS devices through APNs with your authentication key.
  fcm        Send to Android (and iOS) devices through Firebase Cloud Messaging.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash push config set <command> --help' for more about a command.
